title: Past Simple vs Past Continuous
summary: Use Past Continuous for the background action and Past Simple for the completed event.

explanation.en: Past Continuous often shows an action in progress. Past Simple shows the shorter or completed event.
explanation.ru: Past Continuous часто показывает длительное действие-фон, а Past Simple — завершённое или более короткое событие.

examples.en: I was walking home when it started to rain.
examples.ru: Я шёл домой, когда начался дождь.

examples.en: While I was cooking, he was doing homework.
examples.ru: Пока я готовила, он делал домашнее задание.

commonMistakes.wrong: I watched TV when Mum was coming home.
commonMistakes.right: I was watching TV when Mum came home.
commonMistakes.note: The longer background action is usually continuous.

commonMistakes.wrong: While I did homework, she was reading.
commonMistakes.right: While I was doing homework, she was reading.
commonMistakes.note: While often introduces an action in progress.
